run_coco_error_analysis: run COCO error analysis on detection results and save precision recall plots to output directory
analyze_results_function: analyze COCO detection results by computing precision across IoU thresholds, area ranges, and category confusion types
makeplot_function: create a stacked precision recall plot for a COCO category showing confusion, location, and false negative errors
makebarplot_function: generate a bar chart comparing mean average precision across area groups for different error types
analyze_individual_category_function: analyze precision for a single COCO category by ignoring superclass or all other class confusion
